criteria.text: Given a staged diff whose added line contains a secret, When I commit, Then the wall DENIES and names the class and the allowlist command
Given the secret exists only on unchanged context lines, When I commit an unrelated change, Then the diff scan does not fire
Given a confirmed false positive, When I run harness-allowlist add with a reason, Then an audit record (value, reason, author, timestamp) is stored and the next scan skips that line
Given no reason is passed, When I run harness-allowlist add, Then it is refused
Given a push whose range adds a secret, When I push, Then the wall DENIES it; a clean push defers
Given there is no way to disable scanning, When I look for one, Then only per-finding allowlisting exists
